name: HBEL 5381
title: Child Maltreatment: History, Theory, Prevention and Intervention
description: Primarily for students with some practice experience in family and children's services, examines the phenomena of child abuse and neglect and societal and professional responses aimed at their prevention and treatment. As with other courses in the Substantive Area in Family and Children's Services, it is presented in the context of ecologically oriented, family-centered child welfare policy and practice. Elective course for Substantive Area: Focused Area of Study on Social Work with Women and Children in Families.
requirement_description: Open to students in both the MSW program and the STEP program.
